Why pure silk?

Silk is one of the lightest natural fibres. It feels smooth and cool to the touch, and stays comfortable in warm and cool weather alike, which makes it ideal under fine blouses and for summer. Our pure silk lines come in camisoles, tank tops, long-sleeve tops and culotte briefs.

Need more warmth? Choose wool & silk. Read more in our guide.
